title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run scheduled for spring 2027. The route will take her from Nashville to Los Angeles and into some of the largest rooms she has headlined in the United States and Canada.

The tour includes Radio City Music Hall, two nights at Massey Hall and a finale at the Greek Theatre. Those bookings make the jump in scale clear. Young's earlier North American headlining dates were built around much smaller rooms, while the new itinerary arrives after "Messy" turned her into a far bigger draw on both sides of the Atlantic.

The tour name comes from her "Everything Ends" tattoo, reversing the phrase for a run announced after a year spent putting her live career back together. Young cut her remaining 2025 dates short and stepped away from touring, then returned gradually in 2026 through UK headline shows and festival appearances rather than immediately rebuilding the cancelled route. Everything Begins is the first full North American itinerary to follow that break.

"Messy" has remained the song most closely tied to her breakthrough, and it won Best Pop Solo Performance at the Grammys in February. By May, however, Young had new music of her own to carry into the next phase. "From Down Here" was her first original single since *I'm Only F**king Myself* and was created with James Blake after inspiration hit the day following the Grammy win. The song sits in the uneasy space between missing an old high and learning to value being grounded. That makes it a more natural bridge into the new tour than another victory lap around "Messy." It sounds like music made after the interruption, not before it, and gives the return a different emotional center from the album cycle that first pushed her into larger rooms.

Sofia and the Antoinettes will support the announced North American dates. Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time. Tickets are being sold through the official tour channels, with the same support act listed across the announced run.

Everything Begins puts that change in concrete terms. The New York stop, Toronto two-night stand and Los Angeles finale place Young in larger headline rooms than the route she left behind. She is returning to a full North American schedule with a Grammy behind "Messy" and new material ready to share the stage with the song that changed the size of her audience. The interruption remains part of the context, but the announcement is finally about what she is doing next rather than the dates she had to leave behind.
